information:
This competition limits the number of registrations by event:
3x3x3 Multi-Blind: 25
4x4x4 Blindfolded: 25
5x5x5 Blindfolded: 25

Each event will be based on first-come-first-served basis according to the order of registration, and 35 competitors will be the maximum of the number of registrations for other events.

The base registration fee for this competition is ₱500 (Philippine Peso).
Registration fees won't be refunded under any circumstance.

The registration fee for this competition will be Php 500.00 inclusive of all events of your choice.

#### **FTO (Face Turning Octahedron) is also held at this competition** ####
